input.goal: Introduce a backward-compatible pagination API across server and client with a reversible rollout.
acceptance: Old clients still work with the new server.
New clients handle old and new server responses.
End-to-end tests and compatibility matrix pass on the final integrated candidate.
Rollback procedure is rehearsed with isolated fixtures; production deployment is out of scope.
constraints: No production data migration or auto-merge.
Shared contracts are approved before dependent implementations start.

work_units.instructions: Publish the approved backward-compatible pagination contract and consumer fixtures.
Implement the contract and existing API compatibility in an isolated workspace.
Implement consumer support using the fixed contract; retain old-server compatibility.
Exercise mixed versions, rollback conditions and end-to-end behavior against the integrated candidate.
